decisions.statement: Every export named is taken out of the source body in one plan.
The declarations are laid down in the order the source body had them.
A source body declaring nothing exported of a name handed in is refused.
An export naming something its own body declares under no export is refused.
Every kind of exported declaration is carried the same way.
Each declaration is carried whole with the imports that declaration names.
The imports the declarations carried name are written once between them all.
A name carried along with the others is named by no import of its own.
A carried import is spelled from the folder the declarations landed in.
A carried import names what its path exports under the name the body gave it.
An import written here names a type only where the thing that import names is a type.
Carried names sharing one path are written as one import line.
An import naming the landing body is left out however that body is spelled.
An export a carried body names from its own source file is imported from that source file.
Carrying such an import of a value where the two bodies would name each other is refused.
That refusal is judged over every declaration carried rather than over one.
An import the compiler erases is carried back where the two bodies name each other.
A namespace import a carried body names goes with that declaration.
An import the body left behind no longer names goes with the declarations.
Which imports the body left behind no longer names is read once every declaration has gone.
Names the body left behind no longer takes from one line leave that line together.
The import naming those exports at their landing is worked out over the body those departures leave.
That import is one line naming every export the body left behind still takes.
That import is spelled from the root package where the root names a way in.
The import back joins the line the body left behind already takes from that landing.
Every body importing an export carried names the path that export landed at.
A body naming several of those exports is rewritten in one passage.
An export carried joins the line the body naming it already takes from that landing.
A line that body takes from the landing under a default or a namespace is joined by nothing.
A body naming such an export under another name goes on naming the export under that name.
A body naming such an export through a package names the export from the workspace root.
A landing path holding no body is answered as a body to write rather than as a passage.
A declaration lands above the first statement the landing body names it in.
A landing body naming none of them takes the declarations at its end.
A carried import joins the line the landing body already takes from that path.
An import that body already names from another path is refused.
Carrying a declaration that binds a name the landing body already declares is refused.
That refusal names the first such name and the path the declaration would land at.
Which names a declaration and a body bind is read from `bound-names` rather than here.
Nothing here renames a name a declaration binds to make room for it.
A landing body that imported a declaration carried imports it no longer.
A landing path already declaring an export named takes that export no second time.
That export leaves the source body and every importer is repointed either way.
Nothing here writes a body or answers an edit.
Nothing here reaches a change.
A class is no declaration carried here.

definition: the passages carrying named exports out of one code body and into another
